hooks.name: Lint on Save (TypeScript)
hooks.description: Runs lint/format on saved TypeScript files so the evaluator never fails on style. Degrades gracefully until the monorepo lint tooling lands in Phase 0.1.

action.command: if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"' package.json; then npm run lint --silent; else echo "No lint script configured yet (Phase 0.1 pending); skipping."; fi
